items.item_text: Advanced degree in Biology, Molecular Oncology, or related fields and/or equivalent education/training
Ph.D. in Biology, Molecular Oncology, or related field.
Extensive years of experience preparing scientific grant proposals for cancer-focused federal (with an emphasis on the National Cancer Institute), state, and private organizations.

The position will report to the Executive Director of the Office of Grant Development and collaborate with Cancer Center leadership, faculty, and staff across UC Davis. This position will use their extensive experience preparing scientific grant proposals, particularly to the National Cancer Institute and other NIH Institutes as appropriate. Strong scientific writing and editing skills are required, as well as the ability to effectively work in a team environment and manage complex projects.  #CA-SB
15% - Grant Facilitation for the Cancer Center Support Grant
5% - Liaison with Program Officers at Funding Agencies
Advanced level scientific writing, editing, and proofreading skills.
Knowledge of federal grant application procedures, formats, guidelines, and requirements.
Skills working with large amounts of complex technical information.
Skills producing accurate and persuasive text and figures for presentations.
Skills conceptualizing and developing new research, research infrastructure, and training initiatives.

Knowledge and skills working with relevant computer/software system and applications, including MS Windows/Mac OS, MS Office Suite (Excel, Word, PowerPoint), web browser applications and e-mail applications.
Ability to work with confidential materials and information.
Skills working effectively work in a team situation and managing complex projects.
